Overhead the soft warbling of songbirds blends with the chirping crickets below into a sublime symphony of sounds. Small trinkets of adoration and worship have been left at the base of the altar, each one a symbol of devotion to their beloved gods.

[Traders Clearing]
Wagon tracks run through the rocky road, ending just before a row of wooden cabins. Signs hang over the door of the three largest, revealing that they house various shops catering to both the residents of the estate and the many travelers that pass through. The sound of hammer meeting anvil come from the nearest, steel door, while bright lights dance behind the window of the closer wooden door. [Merchant Square]
A small sign has been set in front of the nearby store fronts, listing the local shops: Regal Fashion, Banafin's Bakery, and Sadie's General Store. An eye-catching black striped tiger is emblazoned on the facade of lacquered wooden building on the south side of the square. Its shoulders raised high, and face frozen in a fierce roar. Through the many, high-arched, steel frame windows, a wooden figure can be seen wearing the latest gentleman's fashion. Grey smoke rises from a single stone chimney. A simple plaque hanging from a twisted wrought iron rod reads, "Regal Fashion". Smooth stone steps lead to the entrance. On the east side of the street a large brick chimney funnels white billowy smoke into the air projecting the aroma of fresh baked goods into the area. Through the large bay window a burly human man can be seen kneading and forming dough and placing his creations into an oven. The heavy mahogany door is propped seemingly propped to allow for relief from the ovens intense heat. A quaint barn faces the square from the west side of the street, its interior remodeled into a storefront, as seen through its large bay window.

The area is illuminated.

[Travers Town Square]
Small marble benches are scattered neatly about the square welcoming travelers to take a seat or to possibly empty pebbles from their boots. Cobblestone streets decorate the square alternating from browns to reds in a random pattern. Small statues of the world's races stand behind each bench as if standing sentinel. Tall lamp posts with wrought iron lanterns look down on the neat and clean streets. An occasional waste engineer wanders through, sweeping up dirt and trash into tin dustpans. Tucked away in a corner is an old door leading to a rundown store. The loud echoing of dripping water can be heard coming from a metal grate which is recessed into the street.

The area is illuminated.

[Merchant Square]
A small sign has been set in front of the nearby store fronts, listing the local shops: Regal Fashion, Banafin's Bakery, and Sadie's General Store. An eye-catching black striped tiger is emblazoned on the facade of lacquered wooden building on the south side of the square. Its shoulders raised high, and face frozen in a fierce roar. Through the many, high-arched, steel frame windows, a wooden figure can be seen wearing the latest gentleman's fashion. Grey smoke rises from a single stone chimney. A simple plaque hanging from a twisted wrought iron rod reads, "Regal Fashion". Smooth stone steps lead to the entrance. On the east side of the street a large brick chimney funnels white billowy smoke into the air projecting the aroma of fresh baked goods into the area. Through the large bay window a burly human man can be seen kneading and forming dough and placing his creations into an oven. The heavy mahogany door is propped seemingly propped to allow for relief from the ovens intense heat. A quaint barn faces the square from the west side of the street, its interior remodeled into a storefront, as seen through its large bay window.

The area is illuminated.

[Urdaian Academy Foyer]
A great, arched ceiling draws the eye upward from the vast foyer hall. A spectacular depiction of an ancient and epic battle has been carefully plastered onto the ceiling, making it one of the greatest wonders in a city full of them. Witch-lights of a dozen different colors float weightlessly through the air, each one cast anew everyday by the academy's greatest magic users. Students of every race and creed walk the halls in tenuous peace, understanding that within the walls of the academy, differences must be set aside in favor of the pursuit of perfecting their favored skills. The hum of pious chanting can be heard echoing through the marble floored building from the east, competing with the bustling sounds of the academy's merchant corner to the west.

[Eastern Corridor]
The sublime chanting of holy hymns fills the air to the east, as the gods' faithful raise their voices in prayer to their deities. A pair of portraits of august personages of Urda hang neatly on the walls. One depicts a rugged, well built Vorgnar, his arms pitted from decades of working sputtering forge fires. The other, however, is of a slightly rotund, middle-aged human man, a cheerful smile on his rosy face. Beneath the latter portrait a small golden plaque has been hung and engraved with the words, "In memoriam of Elbanes Penwinter, Former Master of Revels".
